title: [BUG] Claude Code integration with VS Code not working on Windows
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other:
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.2 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: Windows 10
- Terminal:  Ubuntu WSL terminal

## Bug Description
Claude isn't integrated with Visual Studio Code just like it [doesn't with PyCharm](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/1232).  The impression I've gotten is that Claude will install it's extension, since the [installation instructions](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/ide-integrations) just says: "Run claude - the extension will auto-install".  I've search the VS Code marketplace and there isn't extension there from Anthropic to install manually.  I asked Claude and it hallucinated a marketplace link that was a 404.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. In Ubuntu WSL terminal: sudo npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
2. In Ubuntu WSL terminal: claude config set -g autoUpdaterStatus disabled
3. In Visual Studio Code Ubuntu WSL terminal: claude
4. /ide

## Expected Behavior
Says something about being integrated with Visual Studio Code.

## Actual Behavior
This output:
Select IDE                                                                                                       
Connect to an IDE for integrated development features.                                                           
                                                                                                                 
No available IDEs detected. Make sure your IDE has the Claude Code extension or plugin installed and is running. 

## Additional Context

I've attempted to contact support, but haven't been emailed yet.  I also tried installing PyCharm, your plug-in for it, and then using Claude Code from the Ubuntu WSL terminal there.  That didn't work and lead me to the existing [issue](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/1232) about that not working.  Couldn't find an existing issue for VS Code not working on Windows, so opened this.
author: JoshHeitzman

top_comments.body: Thanks for the report @CoderF3ff  - we should have a fix out today (1.0.6)

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body: We've shipped improvements to WSL support and would love to hear if its working better for folks with the latest version of claude (you may have to restart the extension after the new version of claude installs the latest extension).

top_comments.author: igorkofman
top_comments.body: We've identified the WSL2.0 issues and will have a fix shortly
